description: This file defines the RoleRepository class which manages role data, including CRUD operations, permission management, and role assignment logic, using Prisma ORM in a TypeScript project.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing roles, permissions, and user-role assignments in the database.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a role by its name and optional team ID.

methods.name: findByTeamId
methods.description: Retrieves all roles associated with a specific team ID, including system roles.

methods.name: roleBelongsToTeam
methods.description: Checks if a role belongs to a specific team.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new role with specified data and permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a role and its permissions by role ID.

methods.name: reassignUsersToRole
methods.description: Reassigns users from one role to another.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a role by its ID, including permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a role.
